name: GCP GKE Operations Agent
description: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Operations Agent with cluster, node pool, and Kubernetes workload diagnostics, Cloud Logging & Monitoring observability, and official GCP Knowledge lookup.

skills.name: GKE Cluster, Node Pool & Workload Diagnostics
skills.description: Lists and inspects GKE clusters, node pools, cluster health/issues, Kubernetes resources, events, rollout status, and pod logs.
examples: List all GKE clusters in the project and check cluster health and issues
Inspect node pools, Kubernetes events, and diagnose unhealthy workloads

skills.name: GCP Cloud Logging & Monitoring Diagnostics
skills.description: Queries Cloud Logging entries and Cloud Monitoring time-series metrics and alerts for GKE clusters and containers.
examples: Check recent GKE container error logs and pod CPU/memory utilization metrics

skills.name: GCP Documentation & Best Practices Lookup
skills.description: Searches official Google Cloud documentation and architecture guides for GKE best practices.
examples: What are the official GCP best practices for GKE Workload Identity and cluster autoscaling?
